item.title: A Meal à la Nälkä:
item.content:encoded:
I have to say that I have a somewhat strange relationship with body horror. I don't like it at all, but I can't get enough of this religion. I probably wrote this story as a reaction to all the CotbG slice-of-life stories. Because I was surprised that there was hardly anything about the young people of the community. I'm also glad that other writers are now showing a different picture of the followers.

I looked up Foglios but didn't find anything. Who is this artist?

item.title: SCP-5266:
item.content:encoded: The one thing keeping me from confidently upvoting is the formatting of the logs. It's very compressed, you should probably try spacing it out a bit more. Otherwise, this was thoroughly enjoyable.

item.title: A Meal à la Nälkä:
item.content:encoded:
Although I knew this from the Sarkicism Hub while I was writing the tale, I was not aware of it when I chose the title. It is pure coincidence that it has this double meaning. ^>^

But it's still strange that we know so little about the traditional cuisine of the Nälkä followers :P

I hope you like my tale. :>

item.title: Second Contact: Re: Rabes Opinion
item.content:encoded:
I really liked the fact that it wasn't clear. This forced the reader to concentrate on the characters and plot. The beauty of SCI-FI is that you can address these issues by changing the situation without changing the question. (Eeh, it sounds so two-dimensional, but I hope you understand what I mean.) Also the point that our culture and the way we treat our bodies does not automatically apply to other life forms is very real and makes it more interesting to see how we interact. This reminds me of "The Long Way to a Small, Angry Planet", a fantastic book that I only recommend to you.

I'm sorry I'm so late replying, but I swore I wouldn't write a reply until my story was finished, which it is now after more than a year! I'll try to translate it and put it in INT and maybe EN.

item.title: SCP-5266: Author Post
item.content:encoded:
Juxtaposition~!

Thanks to Mooagain, RadioactiveRADS, Cope, Topazshadow, Alongname, and Jabobai for critique and feedback. They helped me refine the idea and come up with the final log.

Anyways, always remember: No matter how seriously the Foundation or anyone else takes itself, it is still always possible for something ridiculous to come out of nowhere to dunk on you. Because anomalies are, by their very definition, weird. And I like weird.

I hope you all enjoy!

item.title: Parenthood: Details and how there could be more
item.content:encoded: Oh boi.. This was weird. Scary, yet its writing felt inadequate in a way. I mean, the dread is derived from secrets and mystery. Buf her anormalies coming out of nowhere? That feels like a bit of lazy writing. It is an interesting concept to read, tho, so if we get more about her, like something from her pov or footnotes, something like that, it would be even more interesting.
